sentences.en: Why don't you give your seat to that old gentleman?
sentences.zh: 为什么你不把座位让给那位老先生？

sentences.en: Like a gentleman, he rose and offered her his seat.
sentences.zh: 像个绅士一样，他起身给她让座。

sentences.en: Why don't you try to behave like a gentleman?
sentences.zh: 为什么不试着表现得像一个绅士呢？

senses.zh: 绅士，有教养的人；先生，男士；君子，正人君子
